correctness.rationale: Real-lift recurrences are algebraically exact. Uniform irrational-rotation sums apply to compact C0 family g_h of mean-zero derivatives. The small-radius hypothesis prevents integer lifts from switching. Three-sample quadratic interpolation gives |h|=O(epsilon/n^2), then |b|=O(epsilon/n); the limiting quadratic coefficient body has exact volume 544/9, and its boundary has measure zero. Haar preservation follows from triangular fiber translations. Finite rational and trigonometric checks in verify.py passed, but infinite quantifiers rest on the analytical proof. The limit is uniform in the center and valid for every fixed radius in the stated interval.

value.rationale: For an entire natural class of 3D irrational skew towers, arbitrary periodic C1 forcing does not alter the exact local n^-3 Haar coefficient, not merely the coarse polynomial exponent. This is a structural universality principle beyond the previously computed linear coefficient and two-dimensional perturbed setting, and offers a quantitative benchmark for nontrivial nilpotent skew dynamics without Diophantine small-divisor restrictions.
